<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>BJP Organizational Strategy:</strong> The BJP is planning a potential reshuffle of its parliamentary board, with reports suggesting that at least four Chief Ministers may be inducted into the party&#x27;s powerful decision-making body.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>International Cooperation:</strong> The Union Cabinet has formally approved new extradition treaties with Kenya, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan to strengthen international legal cooperation.</li>
</ul>
